description: This file contains functions for handling the upgrade process of a Zyxel device within the OpenWrt firmware environment. It includes routines for preparing the environment, handling failures, and setting boot parameters during firmware upgrades.

methods.name: zyxel_mstc_prepare_fail
methods.description: Logs an error message, unmounts all filesystems, and reboots the device to recover from a critical failure during upgrade.

methods.name: zyxel_mstc_upgrade_prepare
methods.description: Prepares the device for a firmware upgrade by verifying partition existence, reading current boot configuration, and switching boot partitions if necessary.
